traditionalDress.men: Mundu, often worn with a shirt or traditional upper cloth.
traditionalDress.women: Kasavu saree or settu mundu, especially associated with festive occasions.

festivals.name: Onam
festivals.description: Kerala's major harvest festival, associated with pookalam floral designs, feasts, traditional games and cultural performances.

festivals.name: Thrissur Pooram
festivals.description: A celebrated temple festival known for ceremonial processions, decorated elephants, percussion ensembles and fireworks.

festivals.name: Vishu
festivals.description: A spring festival marked by the Vishukkani arrangement, family observances and festive food.

music: Chenda melam and temple percussion traditions
folklore: Kerala's storytelling traditions are closely woven with temple arts, ritual performance and epic narratives. Kathakali adapts stories from Indian epics through stylised movement, music and expressive acting.
